verdict.rationale: Navan ships its own AI assistants (Ava, Navan Edge), so letting users plug external MCP servers into them is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, only documents Navan acting as an MCP server that outside clients like Claude and Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Navan's assistants consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools, and server-side evidence belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
